p1.note: Turkish rendered 'مِن حَيْثُ يَطِيبُ لَكُمْ' as 'helal olacak yönden' (now 'hoş gelecek (temiz olacak)'); unmarked note on رُكَبات after the verse moved into a Mütercim notu.
Removed unmarked additions: TR poem gloss [oğulları], (görünen), [ya da nimet]; EN [and the others], [i.e. visible], ummah; otherwise complete and faithful
English gloss of the verse by Zuhayr: "small-headed [i.e. fierce]" was an unmarked addition for the word صعل; replaced with plain "small (ṣuʿl)".
لأن حسد الإنسان لا يكون من عند نفسه: both readings inverted it (TR "dışından olmaz", EN "anywhere but himself"); corrected to literal "not from himself", removed bogus note.
TR rendered وجه الله as "Allah'ın rızası"; changed to "vechi" as in the Arabic.
«أقَرَأتِ الحاجَّةُ» was rendered as the need (ihtiyaç) silently although the text has shadda (al-hajja, female pilgrim); added marked translator note in both
Turkish added unmarked '(meşhur kıraat)' for the tahfif reading; removed it.

p2.note: TR silently rewrites "و”اَلْعالِمُ“، خَبَرًا لِـ”زَيْدٌ“" as "[”هو اَلْعالِمُ“] de ”زَيْدٌ“un haberi olur" (unmarked correction; EN keeps the text and adds a marked note); TR also adds unmarked "[b. el-Ebras]" after "قالَ عَبِيدٌ".

p1.note: Turkish added the unmarked "(atalarindan gelen)" before "bir gecmisi" for the Arabic "falahum sabiqa fi kufrihim"; removed.
TR cited [Âl-i İmrân 4/81]; the surah number is 3 (Arabic [آل عمران: ٨١]); corrected to 3/81.
TR gloss for غُفْرانَكَ، لا كُفْرانَكَ read "Kâfirliğini değil"; corrected to "nankörlüğünü değil".
TR called Moses "(s.a.v.)" where Arabic has موسى ﷺ; changed to (a.s.).
English isnad had unmarked addition [al-Mubarrad]; now marked as translator note.
Turkish had unmarked bracketed explanation after the verse of the two bloods (kanlarimiz birbirine karismayip...) not in the Arabic; removed.

p2.note: TR renders "ولِغَيْرِهِمْ مِن سائِرِ الكُفّارِ الخِزْيُ في الدُّنْيا القَتْلُ" as "Diğer bütün kâfirlerden başkaları için" (= for those other than the disbelievers); Arabic means "for others among the rest of the disbelievers".

p1.note: Turkish rendered غلام in لا رَجُلَ وغُلامًا لَكَ as "kölen" (slave); corrected to "oğlanın" (boy).
Turkish rendered آذان الغنم as "koyunların ağıllarında" (pens) and added unmarked "(gübre ve idrar)"; corrected to "kulaklarında" and removed the addition.

la yadfaʿu ma akhbara bihi ahlu l-kitab: the Prophet’s report does not repel what the People of the Book reported; both readings had reversed it (they said the People of the Book did not reject / could not refute him)
English had "[is hamzated]" added after "وأصلها" outside a translator note; replaced with marked Translator note.
Source text breaks off mid-sentence at "الدَّلِيلُ عَلى أنَّهم ماتُوا"; readings carry a translator note saying so.
English omits the final paragraph on "فَباءُوا بِغَضَبٍ عَلى غَضَبٍ" (meaning of باؤوا, the two views).
Turkish had unmarked addition "Sûr'un sahibi (İsrâfîl)"; Arabic says only "صاحب الصور"; removed the gloss.

Turkish put the thing indicating and the thing indicated the wrong way round: Arabic "ويَدُلُّ عَلى قَوْلِهِ ﴿وَمَن يَرْغَبُ عَنْ مِلَّةِ إبْراهِيمَ﴾ قَوْلُهُ ﴿إنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفى لَكُمُ الدِّينَ﴾" (the latter points to the former); also "يُماتُونَ" rendered as "killed". Both fixed.
English had unmarked gloss "[Ishmael]" after "العَمَّ"; removed.
English had unmarked insertion "[read with a single kasra-nun]" after ﴿فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ﴾; removed.
